log.msg: Built: the dated folder sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<folder>/ draws AISessionDetail (StoreFolder.child reads line 1 of session.jsonl for the id); the id url redirects there with location.replace (AISessionsPage.child looks the folder up, route redirects); AISession.page_url(id, fallback) builds every link (list rows and cards, tree rows, SessionFeed 'session →'). Commits 939997d96, e492147de, 8b5baf660, 5b6d18018 on worktree/session-identity.

Found: a project folder inside a session (sessions-and-tasks/) is drawn from its own page.jsonl (tabs, task cards), and a page made that way had no route, so its task folders 404ed once it sat under the session page. Fixed in AISessionDetail.child (the page gets a route that calls StoreFolder.route). sessions-and-tasks/ now shows its Requirements/Decisions/Tasks tabs and its task cards; a task folder below it opens as a task.

Found: record-only voice sessions (v-zg6h7hl, cloud-voice-app-*) write day as 2026-10-24 (dashes) in the day index snapshot; page_url now reads it as 2026/10/24, so their list links point at the real folder instead of the dead /sessions/2026-10-24/<id>/. The writer of the dashed day is in Servex/Server (AISessionIndex), outside this fence: left as is, page_url tolerates both.

Proof: headless shots at 400 and 1200 in one-url/shots/: folder-*.png (folder url, with tabs Overview/Board/Chat/Cost), uuid-*.png (the full-id url lands on the folder url), task-*.png (…/sessions-and-tasks/session-record/ opens as a task; session-identity itself is uncommitted in the main tree so the worktree cannot show it), project-*.png (…/sessions-and-tasks/ lists its task cards), list-*.png. Zero console errors and zero same-origin 404s on all five pages. node Server/smoke.mjs . /framework/ai/sessions/ --port 54983: 60 ok, no FAIL.

Caveats: the worktree needs gitignored derived files copied from main (tasks.json, usage.json, page-work.json, ai/index.json, the day index.json files, session-e00f55c9/page.jsonl) or its proofs show environment 404s. Smoke on the session folder url itself FAILs only on 2026/10/25/day.jsonl 404 (Approvals.js asks for today's approvals file, which does not exist yet; the same 404 on main) and the console warn budget (Task complete() replay messages, allow-listed on main by ac46ca43f, not in this branch's base): both unrelated to routing and outside the fence.

Left stale for the mastermind: sessions/readme.md 'How data is read' still says One session lives at /framework/ai/sessions/<id>/ and describes StoreFolder as the store only; StoreFolder.js header comment and AISessionDetail's top comment say the same. The AISession readme has the new paragraph. A session whose folder the loaded day indexes do not name (8 of 50 rows in the list) keeps the id link, which redirects, one hop.

complete.outcome: The dated folder is a session's page and /framework/ai/sessions/<id>/ redirects to it; merged with the parent task.
